editor_fail.why: Main picture is a posed family/photo-op shot of Suryakumar Yadav standing between his wife and Prime Minister Modi in front of flags. It is not a cricket picture, shares the frame equally with two other people, and has nothing to do with a Mumbai chase or Mayank Yadav's 5 for 14. It looks like a stand-in. Also the story is a Saturday November 14 match report (about 44 hours old) and ends 'Mumbai and Delhi go into round two as winners' when round two may already have been played; the run found no round-two results.
editor_fail.fix: Name Suryakumar Yadav (solo, batting or in Mumbai/India kit) and rerun the library, quick_photo.py and the finder for a single-person cricket photo of him; do not use the photo with Modi. Mayank Yadav (Delhi bowler) for the in-story slot if found. Check whether round two has been played; if it has, update the story with the latest results or rewrite the closing line, and drop it from the top headlines if it stays Saturday-only.

fixed_by_run.why: Rule 14: an outlet is named in the story. The English body says Gharibabadi 'told the state news agency IRNA' (Hindi twin: 'इरना'), and the infographic source line reads 'IRNA statement' (Hindi: 'इरना का बयान'). Picture (USS Theodore Roosevelt file photo, labelled) and figures (2.1 million barrels a day, 247,000, $95.89, 20+ vessels) check out against the Hindi twin.
fixed_by_run.done: IRNA replaced with 'Iranian state media' in the English and Hindi text and in the infographic source line (verification notes keep it, as metadata).
